name: McLeod County, MN
findings: McLeod County has 158 nonprofit organizations. 79 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 68 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, McLeod County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
